mission: Build TOPA's independent POSS-I artifact-versus-point-source image-forensics stack on public data, preserve raw score distributions, and feed a future score stream into the already frozen opportunity-normalized harmonization test without allowing nuclear outcomes to influence classifier construction.

implemented_components.role: Scientific and semantic contract for labels, features, grouped validation, raw-score preservation, distribution-collapse diagnostics, and harmonization handoff.

Canonical machine-readable feature namespace and leakage policy spanning morphology, pixel shape, plate geometry, cross-scan evidence, modern-epoch evidence, repeat-plate persistence, duplicate geometry, acquisition provenance, field context and future cross-band reconstruction.
Feature rail builder. Adapts public CSV/CSV.GZ/CSV.BZ2 astronomy tables and TOPA JSON/JSONL/NDJSON rails into a single provenance-bearing JSONL/NDJSON feature stream.

Deterministic plate/date-group OOF classifier harness with multiple model families, immutable raw member/ensemble score streams, model bundle hashes, full-population scoring and OOF replacement for training rows.
Pinned public POSS-I intake with transfer/content hash checks, row invariants, optional IRSA FITS-header DATE-OBS/EXPOSURE reconstruction, WCS provenance, and generated feature-build configuration.
Minimal reproducible numerical/ML dependencies for the reference implementation.
CI self-tests for pinned intake, feature rails, group-OOF classifier, harmonization handoff and machine-readable contracts.
Existing streaming machine-readable transport for JSON, JSONL/NDJSON and gzip/bzip2 variants. Reused by the classifier stack rather than inventing a second data plane.
Existing frozen downstream test receiving candidate_quality_score_raw and asking the same artifact-weighted candidate-rate-per-opportunity question for all cohorts.

pinned_public_open_cohort.why_this_commit: The base S0 and tile manifest remain byte-identical to the earlier JANUS pin, while this later frozen commit also contains the public per-row primary_plate_flags sidecar used by the TOPA minimal feature rail. TOPA does not consume upstream main implicitly.

upstream_public_sidecars_and_generators_.rule: Import measurements and failure states; do not inherit the upstream reject threshold as truth.
Keep the continuous measurements even when a hard gate would have rejected a row.
Geometry is a measurement, not an automatic artifact label.
Independent digitisation agreement is strong evidence but not identical to physical source truth; if used to make labels, this family is removed from predictors for that arm.
Coverage and match must be separate fields so unobserved sky is not interpreted as non-persistence.
Single-coverage rows are undecidable, not negative. A repeat-epoch witness can be used for labels only with predictor-family exclusion.

upstream_public_sidecars_and_generators_.upstream: tools/dedup_radius_sweep.py plus a future TOPA per-row duplicate sidecar
upstream_public_sidecars_and_generators_.rule: Global aggregate dedup sweeps are insufficient for a candidate classifier; TOPA still needs per-row duplicate geometry.

validation_contract.training_rows_in_full_population_stream: replace with their preserved OOF score when available

anti_self_deception_gates.witness_leakage: If SuperCOSMOS, PTF, repeat-plate persistence, cross-band evidence, or another feature family contributes to the label, that family cannot be a predictor in that training arm.
anti_self_deception_gates.calibration_collapse: A calibrated sidecar that collapses score resolution cannot replace the raw score stream. Raw member and ensemble streams remain immutable.
anti_self_deception_gates.missingness: Feature extraction failures and unobserved external-catalog regions are preserved explicitly rather than silently coerced to zero evidence.
anti_self_deception_gates.scientific_semantics: A high candidate_quality_score_raw means image evidence is more point-source-like under the trained label contract. It does not prove transient reality, nuclear causation, UAP status, or non-human origin.

real_execution_debts.need: A provenance-bearing real label rail with enough Tier-A direct pixel review and/or Tier-B independent witnesses for both classes. Tier-C heuristics cannot be the sole primary truth.
Generate/import full-candidate morphology, shape, edge, SuperCOSMOS, PTF, repeat-plate and per-row duplicate measurements. Their inclusion must be frozen independently of nuclear-window results.
Execute grouped OOF training/evaluation on real labels and preserve the full raw score distribution and software/model hashes.
After acceptable real OOF performance, score the full public open population and use OOF replacement for labelled training rows.
Restrict the frozen score stream to the scientific study window, join actual observing opportunity, and execute the already frozen DOE/calendar harmonization without changing the classifier.

execution_sequence: generate/freeze expanded public forensic sidecars without consulting nuclear outcomes
construct and freeze a real label JSONL/NDJSON rail with label tiers/sources/witness_families
freeze score-stream hash before nuclear analysis
compare only after all upstream classifier choices are frozen
